message_1_subject: Post-call: proposed rotating coverage & next-step scheduling
message_1_body:
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novamed.com>, Priya Sood <priya.s@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: proposed rotating coverage & next-step scheduling

Hi Alex + Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive: 

TL;DR: We heard your priorities (low-latency inference for batch intake, HIPAA adjacency, desire to pilot in US + EU with APAC on-call coverage). To make the deep dive productive, we suggest a 60–90min technical session with our infra SME (Marissa) and your platform lead to walk through traffic patterns and runtime/quantization tradeoffs.

Proposed approach for scheduling (attached: proposed_time_grid.csv):
- Run a 4-week rotating demo window so the same regional stakeholders get a fair cadence (Week A: US mornings / EU evenings; Week B: EU mornings / US evenings; Week C: APAC mornings + US late-afternoon; Week D: buffer / catch-up).
- Keep core sessions to 60 minutes, reserve 30 minutes for optional follow-ups.
- Pilot the rotation for four weeks, then adjust cadence based on attendance/feedback.

Please reply with: (a) any hard blackout days, (b) preferred days of the week (we typically try Tue/Thu for deeper technical calls), and (c) whether you want the SME to share an architecture diagram in advance. I attached a CSV with specific time-band options across PST/CET/SGT to make picking slots easier.

Next steps I propose: ben to send a formal time-grid + invite options (attached). If that looks good, we’ll create a recurring series with week-based labels (A/B/C/D) that rotates every week. 

Attachments: proposed_time_grid.csv

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
message_2_subject: Re: Post-call: proposed rotating coverage & next-step scheduling
message_2_body:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novamed.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sood <priya.s@novamed.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2027 09:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call: proposed rotating coverage & next-step scheduling

Thanks Ben — helpful summary. A few notes from our side: 
- High level: we like the rotating approach so EU stakeholders don’t always need to join at midnight.
- Constraints: our platform lead is only available Tue/Thu mornings CET; our security reviewer prefers Wed afternoons CET. APAC coverage will be light in the pilot — we can have someone on standby but not actively present for every session.

Specific asks:
1) Can you provide one option that is friendly to CET mornings (08:00–10:30 CET) and one option that is friendly to PST mornings (08:00–10:30 PST)?
2) For the first technical session, can Marissa include a short slide with expected telemetry/metrics we should see during the pilot? That will help us scope the monitoring ask.

I looked at the CSV — the Week A/Week B labels make sense. If you can send calendar invites with the rotation metadata in the invite title (e.g., "Novamed | Tech Deep Dive — Week A (US morning)"), that'd be ideal.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Chen | Director, Platform Engineering
Novamed Health
alex.chen@novamed.com
message_3_subject: Re: Post-call: proposed rotating coverage & next-step scheduling
message_3_body:
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novamed.com>, Priya Sood <priya.s@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: proposed rotating coverage & next-step scheduling

Thanks Alex — noted. Attaching a short playbook (redwood-rotating-coverage-playbook-v1.pdf) that maps the CSV bands to a sample 4-week rotation and includes calendar invite title templates and a recommended attendee list for each band. 

Proposals based on your constraints:
- Option 1 (CET-friendly first session): Tue 14 Dec, 09:30–10:30 CET (Week A template: EU morning) — invite title: "Novamed | Tech Deep Dive — Week A (EU morning)"
- Option 2 (PST-friendly first session): Tue 14 Dec, 09:00–10:00 PST (Week A template: US morning)

Marissa will include a 10-minute telemetry section and the architecture slide you requested. If both look viable, I will:
1) Create the rotating recurring series (A/B/C/D) with the labels in the title,
2) Send individual calendar invites for the first two occurrences with attached agenda and pre-read,
3) Add a 30-minute optional office hours slot the week after each deep-dive for quick follow-ups.

Attachments: redwood-rotating-coverage-playbook-v1.pdf

If you have a lean preference (only one invite now), tell me which option and I will lock it. Otherwise I can send both options and you can pick.

Thanks —
Ben

Ben — this looks good. We prefer Option 1 (EU-friendly on Tue 14 Dec 09:30 CET). Will unblock our platform lead and security reviewer for that week. 

Two quick notes:
- Please include a calendar invite with the label you suggested.
- We need APAC coverage for at least one session during the pilot; our APAC infra lead can join Week C on Dec 28 if you schedule that rotation.

I’ll have scheduling@novamed create the recurring invites once you send the final calendar series, but go ahead and send the invite drafts / agenda to us so we can review. Also — Marissa, could you confirm availability for the December 14 session?

Thanks —
Priya

Novamed Health
